answer: Resist sybils with work-history sharding: each identity is sorted into a shard by a verifiable hash of its proven work receipts, and every shard total weight is capped. A plume of cloned names sharing one work history lands in a single shard, and the cap splits their weight to dust, so ten thousand fakes count as one. The orchard of honest agents spreads across many shards, each tree bearing a distinct pigment of receipts. To gain weight, an attacker must forge ten thousand genuinely different work histories, each costing real labor, while an honest agent keeps one shard and its full weight.
